_note: Mission 1 reasoning questions (approved draft: ภารกิจ/ด่าน_01/คำถามเหตุผล_ร่าง.md). point -> device -> choose/reject -> 3 options. 'correct': true marks the right reason; options without it carry a 'misconception' label used in the summary. The wrong-decision side has no correct option.
